title: Name Your Price
briefing: Kestrel Air is swinging between about $95 and $99. Limit orders are now unlocked: name the price you want and let the market come to you.
objective: A buy limit buys only at your price or lower. A sell limit sells only at your price or higher.
debrief: Kestrel Air swung up and down in a range all match. A buy limit placed near the bottom of the range filled on a dip at your price or better, with no spread to pay, and a sell limit near the top took profit on the next swing up. Limits set too far away never filled, which is the trade-off: price control in exchange for no guarantee of a fill.

assets.name: Kestrel Air
assets.blurb: Flies short routes between the region's island cities.

basic.text: Place a limit order (try a buy limit below the market price)
Get at least one order filled

bonus.text: Place at least 2 limit orders (try an entry and a take-profit)
